name: Keep EditorFunctions.nox by hand, without the generator
body: `tools/generate-host-functions.py` wrote `src/EditorFunctions.nox` from `EditorHost.cpp`'s `RegisterFunction` calls. With `EditorHost.cpp` gone, `EditorFunctions.nox` is the source: delete the script, and say in the README that a new `editor*` function is added there by hand.

comments.text: Done in the M5 PR; stays in-progress until it merges.
